steps.line: * Given a notebook is open with every heading folded

expect.why: the notebook's whole text is open in the window

expect.that:
def lines: "# One
Alpha line.
# Two
Beta line.
# Three
Gamma line.
# Four
Delta line.
# Five
Epsilon line.
" | split("
") | .[:-1] | reduce .[] as $l ({o: 0, ls: []}; .ls += [{offset: .o, text: $l}] | .o += (($l | length) + 1)) | .ls; (lines | map(select(.text | startswith("#")) | {offset, line: .text})) == (.folded.json.sections.notebook.folded | map({offset, line}) | sort_by(.offset))
expect.why: every heading of the notebook is folded

expect.why: the folded headings hide the text under them

steps.line: * When the user chooses View > Unfold All
* Then the view shows the whole text of the file

expect.why: the view holds the file's whole text

expect.that:
def lines: "# One
Alpha line.
# Two
Beta line.
# Three
Gamma line.
# Four
Delta line.
# Five
Epsilon line.
" | split("
") | .[:-1] | reduce .[] as $l ({o: 0, ls: []}; .ls += [{offset: .o, text: $l}] | .o += (($l | length) + 1)) | .ls; lines as $lines | .unfolded.json.sections.notebook | .length as $n | [.drawn[] | {offset, text}] as $d | $d == $lines or $d == $lines + [{offset: $n, text: ""}]
expect.why: the window draws every line of the file, in order, at its offset
every line takes room on screen and none is drawn over another
